documents.title: Regulatory Compliance Strategy — Draft
documents.excerpt: A draft regulatory strategy register lists planned conformity-assessment activities and change-control responsibilities. No approved procedure or executed records are attached.

documents.title: GSPR Mapping — Working Copy
documents.excerpt: An incomplete worksheet lists selected GSPR headings and possible verification methods. Requirement coverage and traceability are not verified.

documents.title: Management Responsibility Charter — Draft
documents.excerpt: A provisional responsibility matrix identifies management roles but contains no controlled approval or effectiveness evidence.

documents.title: Preliminary Risk Management Plan
documents.excerpt: Preliminary hazard brainstorming for ECG interpretation errors is recorded. Risk acceptability, residual risks, Annex I alignment and approval remain open.

documents.title: Clinical Evaluation Outline
documents.excerpt: The outline proposes clinical evidence activities and a PMCF approach but does not include completed clinical evaluation or PMCF records.

documents.title: Post-Market Surveillance Plan — Draft
documents.excerpt: A high-level PMS plan draft describes monitoring sources. It has not been implemented or validated.

documents.title: CAPA Process Outline
documents.excerpt: A CAPA workflow draft lists corrective action stages. No effectiveness verification records are attached.
